briefings.title: The AI Productivity Boom with David Solomon
briefings.channel: The Economic Club of New York
briefings.tldr: While AI will cause near-term job dislocation and require significant labor upskilling, it is poised to unleash a generational productivity and economic growth boom supported by massive capital market liquidity, even as businesses face rising cyber risks and macroeconomic pressures.

briefings.title: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon on Running a Bank in the Age of AI | Odd Lots
briefings.tldr: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon argues that while AI will dramatically boost productivity and reshape job structures, fears of a white-collar "job apocalypse" are overblown because emotional intelligence, trust, and human relationships remain irreplaceable business drivers.

briefings.title: Global Markets, World Uncertainties and the $2 Trillion Fund | Jens Stoltenberg & David Solomon
briefings.tldr: While geopolitical instability in the Middle East and structural stagnation in Europe present significant short-term risks, long-term economic optimism remains high due to the transformative productivity potential of AI and the continued compounding power of global equity markets.

briefings.title: Ben Horowitz & David Solomon on Why Scale Is The Only Thing That Matters
briefings.tldr: The current macro environment offers a "sweet spot" for financial assets, driven by significant stimulus and a capital investment super cycle that's poised to drive strong M&A and IPO activity.
